exposure: Immediate skin-to-skin contact in the operating theatre
Length of time for which skin-to-skin was performed
cohort: The study included 366 women undergoing an elective caesarean section at term who chose to breastfeed their baby at birth.
finding: Immediate skin-to-skin contact in the operating theatre after an elective caesarean section showed a non-significant trend towards increased breastfeeding rates at 48 hours and 6 weeks, but there was a significant correlation between the length of time skin-to-skin was performed and continuing breastfeeding at 48 hours.
mod_finding: The intervention of immediate skin-to-skin contact in the operating theatre following an elective caesarean section was investigated for its effect on breastfeeding outcomes.
